groups.name: grails.async.streaming
groups.description: Streaming of a reactive Publisher returned from a controller action as server-sent events.

properties.name: grails.async.streaming.enabled
properties.description: Whether a `Publisher` returned from a controller action is written to the client as a stream of server-sent events.

properties.name: grails.async.streaming.timeout
properties.description: How long a streamed response may stay open, for example `5m`. When not set, a stream has no timeout, as Spring MVC's server-sent event streams have none.
